title: 多源数据融合驱动的居民出行特征分析方法
journal: 交通运输系统工程与信息
authors: 苏跃江;温惠英;韦清波;吴德馨
abstract: Copyright © 2020 by Science Press. This study proposes an analysis method to investigate residents' travel characteristics based on multi-source data fusion by using traditional household travel survey and transportation big data. The residents travel characteristics were initially analyzed through a combination of traditional household survey data analysis (age, occupation, vehicle ownership, population distribution) and mobile phone signaling data analysis (travel frequency distributions). Then, the residents' travel characteristics were further analyzed through mobile phone signaling, Intelligent Card (IC), Automatic Fare Collection (AFC), the Global Positioning System(GPS) and other big data. The analysis results include residents' travel time distribution, Origin-Designation (OD) distribution, and travel mode structure. The resident travel characteristics of Guangzhou, China was analyzed as an example. The study then compared the proposed method with traditional household survey data analysis methods. The results indicated that about 30% residents' trips were not recognized by traditional household sampling surveys; the proportion of travel rate of twice a day generated by these two methods were 39.5% different; and the differences generated by these two methods for non-commuting trips, bus trips in PM peak hours, and subway trips in PM peak hours were respectively 7.4%, 8.1%and 12.6%. Compared with the traditional method, the multi-source data fusion analysis method is more effective to identify and analyze residents travel characteristics. It plays an important role to examine and balance residents' travel needs with the time and space distributions.
abstractZh: 本研究结合传统居民家庭出行调查和交通大数据，提出一种基于多源数据融合的居民出行特征分析方法。首先，将传统家庭调查数据分析（年龄、职业、车辆拥有情况、人口分布）与手机信令数据分析（出行频次分布）相结合，初步分析居民出行特征；随后，进一步利用手机信令、智能卡（IC）、自动售检票（AFC）、全球定位系统（GPS）等大数据进行分析。分析结果包括居民出行时间分布、起讫点（OD）分布和出行方式结构。以中国广州为例分析居民出行特征，并将所提方法与传统家庭调查数据分析方法进行比较。结果表明，约30%的居民出行未被传统家庭抽样调查识别；两种方法得到的每日出行两次的比例相差39.5%；非通勤出行、晚高峰公交出行及晚高峰地铁出行的差异分别为7.4%、8.1%和12.6%。与传统方法相比，多源数据融合分析方法能够更有效地识别和分析居民出行特征，对于考察与平衡居民出行需求的时空分布具有重要作用。
